paite: Aw, nang van a tu, nang lam ah ka mit ka suantou zel hi.
heading: Zahngaihna Ngen A Thumna
english: A Song of Ascents. I lift up my eyes to you, you who sit in the heavens.

paite: Ngai in, sikhate mit in apu khut a-et nak bang in leh, sikhanu mit in api khut a-et bang in, i mit in TOUPA lam a-en nilouh ahi, ahon hehpih masiah.
english: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to Yahweh, our God, until he has mercy on us.

paite: Ka tung uah zahngai in, TOUPA aw, ka tung uah zahngai in, muhsitna in ka dim sinsen uhi.
english: Have mercy on us, Yahweh, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.

paite: Minuamsate simmohna leh kisatheite muhsitna in ka hinna uh adim hi.
english: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.
